title: In-Place Home Resale Package Line-Up and Entry Requirements
content:
**Hearthstone Home Sales — In-Place Home Resale package schedule: entry requirements.** The In-Place Home Resale program is offered in six packages, ranked below from the approval-only service to the guaranteed program. A resale file is opened on a package only where the seller's site lease and the home meet that package's entry requirements.

| Rank | Package | Seller's site lease | Home stays on its site | Home model year | Home section type |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Resale Approval Service | active or under notice to vacate | required | no requirement | no requirement |
| 2 | Owner-Marketed Listing Package | active or under notice to vacate | required | no requirement | no requirement |
| 3 | Assisted Resale Listing | active or under notice to vacate | required | 1990 or later | no requirement |
| 4 | Full-Service Resale Brokerage | active or under notice to vacate | required | 1995 or later | no requirement |
| 5 | Full-Service Resale Brokerage Plus | active or under notice to vacate | required | 2000 or later | no requirement |
| 6 | Guaranteed Resale Program | active or under notice to vacate | required | 2012 or later | multi-section home |

## Sales outside the program

A sale in which the buyer will remove the home from the community is not covered by any of the six packages: removal sales are handled under no In-Place Home Resale package.

| Package | Removal sale covered |
|---|---|
| Resale Approval Service | No |
| Owner-Marketed Listing Package | No |
| Assisted Resale Listing | No |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage | No |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage Plus | No |
| Guaranteed Resale Program | No |

## Reading the model-year column (hypothetical homes)

| Home | Assisted Resale Listing | Full-Service Resale Brokerage | Full-Service Resale Brokerage Plus | Guaranteed Resale Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1989 single-section | does not meet | does not meet | does not meet | does not meet |
| 1990 single-section | meets | does not meet | does not meet | does not meet |
| 2004 multi-section | meets | meets | meets | does not meet |
| 2012 single-section | meets | meets | meets | does not meet (not multi-section) |
| 2012 multi-section | meets | meets | meets | meets |

Each example assumes a site lease that is active or under notice to vacate and a home that stays on its site; the Resale Approval Service and the Owner-Marketed Listing Package set no model-year or section requirement.
